metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.description: Validates GET /v1/jiminy/latest — the per-prompt read prompt-context.sh pipes through jq (RRF-SCALE-001 Follow-up C investigated its JSON escaping; closed as a non-issue because writeJSON always escapes control chars — this spec is the standing strict-JSON contract for that surface). CONTRACT UNION: warm=true responses carry data/age_ms/compute_ms; warm=false carries status='no_guidance_available'. Only $.warm (boolean) is unconditional; state-dependent fields assert as optional so the spec passes in either warmth state.

variants.name: missing_space_id
variants.description: Missing space_id query param is a 400 request-validation failure.

variants.name: disabled_contract_503
variants.skip_reason: Requires JIMINY_ENABLED=false or JIMINY_WARM_ENABLED=false + restart; documented contract: 503 with the corresponding gate error message.
